claim: MNTS: board adopted a rights plan on 24 Nov
quote: On November 24, 2026, the Board of Directors (the "Board") of Momentus Inc.
note: 8-K filed 25 Nov; release published 01:01 UTC 25 Nov (before that day's open)

quote: Generally, an "Acquiring Person" is a Person that, together with its Affiliates and Associates (as defined in the Rights Agreement), Beneficially Owns 10% or more of the outstanding Common Shares, subject to the exceptions described below.

claim: MNTS: Burkle's group is named and grandfathered
quote: Ronald Wayne Burkle, OA3, LLC, Kenneth James Abdalla and Warrior Global Holdings, LLC, together with their respective Affiliates and Associates (the "Specified Group"), are deemed a single group, and the Specified Group and each member are expressly Grandfathered Stockholders deemed to Beneficially Own all Common Shares Beneficially Owned by any member, regardless of whether they constitute a group under federal securities laws.

claim: MNTS: any further purchase by the group triggers the plan
quote: A Grandfathered Stockholder that subsequently acquires Beneficial Ownership of additional Common Shares becomes an Acquiring Person unless, upon that acquisition, it Beneficially Owns less than 10% of the outstanding Common Shares.

claim: MNTS: flip-in at twice the exercise price
quote: each valid Right entitles its holder, upon exercise after the Distribution Date in accordance with the Rights Agreement, to receive Common Shares instead of Preferred Shares, having a value equal to twice the applicable exercise price
outstanding at the Close of Business on December 4, 2026 (the "Record Date")
The Rights will expire on the Close of Business on November 24, 2027.

claim: MNTS: board can still consider a proposal
quote: It does not prevent the Board from considering an acquisition proposal or redeeming the Rights before any Person becomes an Acquiring Person.
